name: Navigate the page and use its key contact links
description: Verifies visitors can move through the main sections and reach the supplied booking and helpdesk destinations.
steps: Use the navigation to open Services and FAQ
Open the Book a Session link and the Helpdesk link
Open Contact and inspect the phone and address details
expected: The matching sections and supplied links work, and both telephone numbers and the Abuja address are visible in Contact.

name: Use the mobile navigation and FAQ
description: Verifies the mobile menu opens and closes and FAQ answers can be expanded.
steps: Open the page at a mobile viewport
Open the navigation menu and choose Programs
expected: The menu closes after navigation, the Programs section is reached, and the selected answer is shown.

name: Validate and submit the inquiry form
description: Verifies invalid contact details are rejected and valid form content receives a clear success response.
steps: Submit the inquiry form with fields empty
Enter a valid name, email, phone, interest, and message
expected: The empty form shows field errors; valid entries show the form's success message and clear the inputs.
